Imagine waking up in a world where artificial intelligence isn’t just a buzzword, but a real force shaping the way we live, work, and even think. Sounds a bit overwhelming, doesn’t it? But here’s the thing—this world isn’t some far-off dream. It’s happening right now, and the choices we make today are already echoing into our future. Together, we’re about to step into Scary Smart: The Future of Artificial Intelligence and How You Can Save Our World, a journey envisioned by Mo Gawdat. Instead of just focusing on technology for technology’s sake, we’ll dig into the true heart of the matter: how AI is pushing us to ask deep questions about ethics, society, and what it really means to be human.
We’ll look at the breathtaking speed of AI’s evolution—and yes, the unpredictable twists that come with giving machines more autonomy. It’s a story that’s equal parts hope and caution, as we figure out how to stay in the driver’s seat and keep our values close, even when the lines between human and machine decisions start to blur.
What if we could steer AI toward solving some of humanity’s biggest challenges? What if our individual choices actually made a difference in the kind of future we create? That’s the invitation woven through this exploration—one that connects technology, philosophy, and the very personal side of our relationship with intelligent machines.
So, as we set off together, let’s get curious. Let’s open ourselves to new ideas, face a few tough questions, and discover how each of us can help shape the world we’re building—side by side with AI. Ready to dive in?
